core.title: 18 Inch R-Series Towel Shelf, Deltana R2015

text.description_html:
Deltana R2015, Frosted Glass 18" Shampoo Shelf

Solve your bathroom storage issues with this classic glass shelf; just mount it to the wall and store anything on it from hand towels to shampoo. It is easily to coordinate with your existing furnishing because the solid brass brackets are available in 8 finishes while the shelf is made out of glass. The traditional look of this shelf means that it is timeless, easily adapting to almost any decor. It is made with the attention to quality and beauty that is expected for Deltana. And this is not just for the bathroom, it would look just as great in the kitchen as a spice rack, in the living room to display knick knacks, or in the bedroom as a bookshelf--just think of the possibilities!

Shop more of the Deltana R-Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the R Series Traditional 18 Inch Glass Bathroom Shelf:

  • Material: solid brass wall mount with a glass shelf.
  • Overall Length: 20-1/4"
  • Center to Center Length: 17-7/8"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Shelf Width: 3-7/8"
  • Overall Projection: 6"
  • Projection From Wall to Bar: 1-5/8"
  • Deltana R2015 18" Towel Shelf Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 shelf, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
